literal_meaning: মুখটি যেন খোলা ভাজনার মতো (the face/mouth is like an open cauldron)
figurative_meaning_en: to speak hurriedly or chatter rapidly
similar_in_english: to run off at the mouth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মুখখানি যেন ভাজনা খোলা, একটানা কথা বলতে থাকে।
বাজারে গিয়ে তার মুখখানি যেন ভাজনা খোলা হয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He talks as if his mouth is an open cauldron, nonstop.
In the market, her mouth becomes like an open cauldron.
note: Refers to traditional earthenware pots common in rural Bengali households, evoking imagery of something wide and uncontained.
